title: Gravitee API cohort commissioning and independent operating handover

task.name: Commission and independently receive a complete selected API cohort
task.purpose: Give the customer's API owner and receiving engineer a complete path from original API source and explicit mappings through native Gravitee Management API changes, retained deployment and gateway observations, source review and an editable independent handover.
task.request: Agree the entire named API cohort and its source, identity, transformation, documentation and receiving scope. Receive complete OpenAPI, Swagger, RAML with relative includes, original Gravitee definitions and any required companion transformation source. Capture the current native API definitions, export, all plans and resource pages, documentation and deployment state before changes. Review every source behavior and its actual implementation or agreed disposition. Save the exact draft and mapping hash. Select each original Management API connection, organisation/environment and real gateway separately. Prepare native changes, inspect the complete method/path/body and current target, then execute through the original request and parent/child sequence. Read the real creation, plan, review, publication, start and deployment responses; an accepted deployment request remains distinct from observed gateway traffic. Preserve full observations for each agreed staging and production target and relevant business journey. Keep errors, incomplete collections and unsupported transformations visible. Complete original documentation, recovery instructions, source and operator review. Receive the complete source-bearing workspace on the named independent host, rebind host-local credentials, operate the exact delivered edition at desktop and narrow widths, inspect actual images, use downloads and cold reopen. Save actual Installation outcomes against the original Workshare phases.
task.completeOutput: One complete selected API cohort with original source/mapping editions, native connection and API identities, complete Management API responses and journals, actual deployment/gateway observations, attributed acceptance and recovery decisions, editable product/source handover, installed runtime selection, independent receive/reopen results and the same original commercial Installation.
task.repeatTrigger: A real new API cohort, supported source or policy revision, changed identity/transformation contract or agreed subsequent operating edition creates useful following work. Reconnecting, retrying an original request or downloading another format continues its original operation.
task.pricedUnit: One agreed whole API-cohort commissioning and receiving task. Select the actual merchant-priced unit and whole-task atomic budget in the original case. Keep engineering fees, phase effort, schedule, support and changes in the original Workshare; this profile assigns no customer price.

source.reference: The exact complete original Gravitee handover, its workspace/package/file identities and all explicitly selected draft/commissioning records; original commercial Workshare and approved source/target scope.
source.mode: Immutable complete source directories and Management API v2 observations for supported v4 HTTP proxy APIs, with explicit native operation preparation and execution. Default bundled contract is APIM4.12.21; select the actual installed contract when different. Host environment variables supply credentials.
source.population: All agreed API definitions, relative source files, plans/statuses, native resource pages, mappings, documentation, events, deployment definitions and selected gateway/business-journey outputs. Preserve excluded draft/commissioning heads with their actual reason; each preparation retains the whole original package.
source.meaning: Keep workspace and record revision/SHA, API and connection identity, organisation/environment, current versus original deployment, native statuses, expected HTTP status and full returned body separate. Source authentication, client/scopes, path/verb/schema and transformation meaning remain explicit. A Management API acceptance is an observed request result; service behavior is read from the corresponding original gateway/business result.
source.changePolicy: Receive later source as a new original edition, review changed mappings and targets, and keep the previous capture. Preserve native ETag/current-definition checks and same original request/child IDs after uncertainty. Saved commercial changes use a later draft of the same Installation. Stop or withdraw through the original authorized native operation and retain its actual result.

receiving.application: Existing products/gravitee-merchant workspace and gravitee-workspace Applications provider, delivered with the original Grant Operations Installation workspace through the gravitee-installation source selection. The private workspace must be initialized through the original CLI or received from its complete handover before Applications preparation.
receiving.acceptanceRule: The source report binds the complete original handover to the exact case attachment, full explicit cohort and current Workshare seed. Each required acceptance step uses the original selected API/connection/source edition and actual response or operator observation. All original terms/checks/funding assignments remain intact. Review every remaining difference explicitly. Independently receive the full Gravitee package and complete original Installation case, compare selected edition identities, open and use the delivered software, inspect desktop/narrow images and reopen complete downloads.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer API owner retains native platform and rollout authority. The receiving engineer changes source/mapping/connection selection through the existing application; credentials stay in host-owned environment configuration. A reviewed rollback identifies an actual event in the selected API, dispatches the original operation and recaptures its result. Commercial/funding changes remain in the current Installation/Workshare.
receiving.recovery: After lost output, retain the same original request, complete body, source/package SHA and receiving directory. Read the original operation/request or saved export reference before replay. Native 429 replies preserve provider timing or the labeled local delay. An uncertain result follows original reconciliation. The full receiving marker pins package/workspace/destination and preserves subsequent recipient edits on replay. Installation request/version guards and full-case import stay in the original Operations application.
receiving.maintenance: Name the source owner, API platform operator, implementation engineer, commercial prime and independent receiver. Deliver complete runtime/source manifests, original package, selected installed contract, environment-variable names, guides and agreed support. Keep actual credential values and customer source in their existing private paths. Existing grants and commercial work retain their separate original cost/revenue assignments.

steps.title: Receive the complete commercial and source scope
steps.result: Open the current original Installation or receive its complete Workshare seed. Select all agreed APIs, environments, source files, source rights, acceptance phases and complete output. Retain original terms, phase effort and funded assignments.

steps.title: Install both maintained applications
steps.result: Use the complete gravitee-installation recipe to receive the existing Gravitee and Grant Operations providers. Inspect its source/runtime manifest. Initialize the original private API workspace or receive its full handover, then prepare and start that exact directory through Applications with host-local environment references.

steps.title: Capture the original API population
steps.result: Read every current native resource/page for the agreed cohort. Preserve complete API definitions/exports/plans/docs/members/metadata/events/deployment and original errors before change.

steps.title: Review source meaning and editable configuration
steps.result: Import full source bundles and includes, save exact drafts, and resolve authentication/policy/transformation behavior against real implementations. Keep unsupported work and explicit exclusions visible.

steps.title: Bind the full operating edition to Installation
steps.result: Attach the exact source-bearing handover to the original case. Read a fresh case and Workshare seed, generate complete cohort/binding templates, explicitly include/exclude every draft/commissioning head, then prepare the full source report/workorder and existing native Installation input.

steps.title: Operate native changes and actual receiving
steps.result: Review complete native request and current target; execute same parent/child operation. Read deployment requests separately from actual gateway observations for each target. Preserve source, native responses, errors, changes and actual recovery.

steps.title: Record attributed acceptance and useful following work
steps.result: Review all required original checks against the chosen source and observations. Save genuine outputs, purchases and outcomes only where actually observed. New API/source work keeps its own useful business purpose and original linked history.

steps.title: Receive the complete independent handover
steps.result: Download the full populated Gravitee package and installed runtime/source selection. Independently receive on a new private host/directory, rebind environment credentials, compare the original full record/source identities, cold reopen and operate the actual application.

steps.title: Preserve the whole original Installation
steps.result: Use its native preview/save and full-case export/import, receive the selected installation independently and verify source attachments, Workshare and selected edition. Retain unresolved choices, original request/result and support owner.

steps.title: Inspect the actual outgoing experience
steps.result: Open the exact resulting wide/narrow screens, read the actual images, operate important controls, export and reopen the real downloads. Correct displayed defects before recording rendered completion.

inputs: Complete original Workshare commissioning source and packet; same current Operations case, pinned plan and unoperated initial seed or existing saved Installation.
Complete authorized OpenAPI/Swagger/RAML/Gravitee source, every include and relevant transformation/documentation file; exact original source roles and exclusion reasons.
Exact full original Gravitee handover JSON plus workspace/package/raw-byte hashes; all draft/commissioning heads with explicit source/target selection.
Actual Management API connection/organisation/environment, installed contract and gateway URLs; host-owned credential environment references.
Actual source use authority, named platform/source/receiving owners and agreed staging/production/business journeys.
Current complete Operations show result, exact attached handover source ID/hash, matching Workshare seed and original customer/payment/deployment bindings.
Whole installed application/runtime manifest and full editable workspace/source package; independent private receiving directory and original case workspace.
Actual observations, recovery actions, attributed acceptance, rendered desktop/narrow images and complete export/reopen results.
